input.query: reset password token revoke refresh tokens sessions

candidates.explanation: After a successful reset, the code only updates the user's password. It never deletes or invalidates the user's existing sessions, for example with sessionService.deleteByUserId. A device that was already signed in still has a valid session and refresh hash. It can keep calling refreshToken and get new tokens. AuthService.update does revoke other sessions when the password changes. The reset flow has no equivalent step.

fix.description: In resetPassword, after usersService.update succeeds, delete all of the user's sessions. Add a deleteByUserId method to SessionService and its repositories if one doesn't exist. Then call it with user.id, so every refresh token stops working.
